import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

TRUNK = 48
CTX = 32
ENC = 48
LF = 32
P = 16
H = 16


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        C = spec.in_channels
        Z = self.Z
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(C, TRUNK, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(TRUNK, CTX, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(CTX, CTX, 3, padding=1)
        nin = 4 * (2 * Z + 1) + 3 + Z
        self.enc1 = nn.Conv2d(nin, ENC, 1)
        self.enc2 = nn.Conv2d(ENC, LF, 1)
        self.ctx_proj = nn.Conv2d(CTX, LF, 1)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(LF, P, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * P, H, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(H, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * CTX, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def layer_inputs(self, obs):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        groups = []
        for g in range(4):
            grp = obs[:, g * Z:(g + 1) * Z]
            padded = F.pad(grp, (0, 0, 0, 0, Z, Z))
            win = torch.stack([padded[:, z:z + 2 * Z + 1] for z in range(Z)], 1)
            groups.append(win)
        rest = obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 3].unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, 3, Y, X)
        zid = torch.eye(Z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, Z, Z, 1, 1).expand(B, Z, Z, Y, X)
        inp = torch.cat(groups + [rest, zid], 2)
        return inp.reshape(B * Z, inp.shape[2], Y, X)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        h = F.relu(self.enc1(self.layer_inputs(obs)))
        h = self.enc2(h).view(B, Z, LF, Y, X) + self.ctx_proj(f).unsqueeze(1)
        h = F.relu(h).reshape(B * Z, LF, Y, X)
        p = self.proj(h)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            o = out(F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], 1))))
            o = o.reshape(B, Z, Y * X)
            res.append(torch.logsumexp(o, dim=1))
        place = torch.cat(res, 1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], 1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], 1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.002, "ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ent_coef": 0.003, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 48
D = 48
HEADS = 4
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class Block(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d, heads):
        super().__init__()
        self.h = heads
        self.n1 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(d, 3 * d)
        self.o = nn.Linear(d, d)
        self.n2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.f1 = nn.Linear(d, 2 * d)
        self.f2 = nn.Linear(2 * d, d)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, N, Dm = x.shape
        hd = Dm // self.h
        qkv = self.qkv(self.n1(x)).view(B, N, 3, self.h, hd).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        q, k, v = qkv[0], qkv[1], qkv[2]
        a = torch.softmax(torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-1, -2)) / math.sqrt(hd), dim=-1)
        y = torch.matmul(a, v).transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, N, Dm)
        x = x + self.o(y)
        x = x + self.f2(F.relu(self.f1(self.n2(x))))
        return x


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        Y, X = int(spec.Y), int(spec.X)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(STEM, D, 3, padding=1)
        self.pos = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, D, Y, X) * 0.02)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([Block(D, HEADS) for _ in range(2)])
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(D)
        self.head = PoolHead(D, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * D, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s)) + self.pos
        t = x.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        for blk in self.blocks:
            t = blk(t)
        t = self.norm(t)
        f = t.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, D, Y, X)
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.002, "ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ent_coef": 0.003, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
U = 32
H1 = 48
H2 = 32


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.ks = [max(a, b) for a, b in self.fps]
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.u = nn.Conv2d(COL + WIDTH, U, 1)
        self.k1 = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(U, H1, k) for k in self.ks])
        self.k2 = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(H1, H2, 1) for _ in self.ks])
        self.k3 = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(H2, 1, 1) for _ in self.ks])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH + U, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        u = F.relu(self.u(torch.cat([s, f], 1)))
        res = []
        for k, a, b, c in zip(self.ks, self.k1, self.k2, self.k3):
            q = F.pad(u, (0, k - 1, 0, k - 1)) if k > 1 else u
            h = F.relu(a(q))
            h = F.relu(b(h))
            res.append(c(h).flatten(1))
        place = torch.cat(res, 1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3)), u.amax((2, 3))], 1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], 1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.001, "ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 64
W = 48
FL = 16
HID = 256


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Y = int(spec.Y)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.np = int(spec.n_place)
        self.T = self.np // (self.Y * self.X)
        cin = int(spec.in_channels) + self.T
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, W, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.red = nn.Conv2d(2 * W, FL, 1)
        n = FL * self.Y * self.X
        self.fc = nn.Linear(n, HID)
        self.pi_direct = nn.Linear(n, int(spec.n_actions))
        self.pi_hid = nn.Linear(HID, int(spec.n_actions))
        self.v = nn.Linear(HID, 1)
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.pi_direct.weight, 0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.pi_direct.bias)
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.pi_hid.weight, 0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.pi_hid.bias)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        m = mask[:, :self.np].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.T, self.Y, self.X)
        s = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, m], 1))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        r = F.relu(self.red(torch.cat([s, f], 1)))
        flat = r.flatten(1)
        h = F.relu(self.fc(flat))
        logits = self.pi_direct(flat) + self.pi_hid(h)
        return logits, self.v(h).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.001, "ppo_epochs": 2, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ent_coef": 0.01, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
RED = 8


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Y = int(spec.Y)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.np = int(spec.n_place)
        self.T = self.np // (self.Y * self.X)
        cin = int(spec.in_channels) + self.T
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.red = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH + COL, RED, 1)
        self.direct = nn.Linear(RED * self.Y * self.X, self.np)
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.direct.weight, 0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.direct.bias)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH + RED * self.Y * self.X, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        m = mask[:, :self.np].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.T, self.Y, self.X)
        s = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, m], 1))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        r = F.relu(self.red(torch.cat([s, f], 1))).flatten(1)
        place = self.head(f) + self.direct(r)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3)), r], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.001, "ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 64
W = 32
D = 64
HEADS = 4
HID = 48


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Y = int(spec.Y)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.np = int(spec.n_place)
        self.T = self.np // (self.Y * self.X)
        N = self.Y * self.X
        cin = int(spec.in_channels) + self.T
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, W, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.tok = nn.Linear(2 * W, D)
        self.pos = nn.Embedding(N, D)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(D)
        self.k = nn.Linear(D, D)
        self.v = nn.Linear(D, D)
        self.aq = nn.Embedding(self.np, D)
        self.qp = nn.Linear(D, D)
        self.m1 = nn.Linear(D, HID)
        self.m2 = nn.Linear(HID, 1)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * D, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        Y, X = self.Y, self.X
        hd = D // HEADS
        m = mask[:, :self.np].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.T, Y, X)
        s = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, m], 1))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        t = torch.cat([s, f], 1).flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        t = self.norm(self.tok(t) + self.pos.weight.unsqueeze(0))
        N = t.shape[1]
        k = self.k(t).view(B, N, HEADS, hd).transpose(1, 2)
        v = self.v(t).view(B, N, HEADS, hd).transpose(1, 2)
        q = self.qp(self.aq.weight).view(1, self.np, HEADS, hd).transpose(1, 2)
        a = torch.softmax(torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-1, -2)) / math.sqrt(hd), dim=-1)
        o = torch.matmul(a, v).transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, self.np, D)
        o = o + self.aq.weight.unsqueeze(0)
        h = F.relu(self.m1(o))
        place = self.m2(h).squeeze(-1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([t.mean(1), t.amax(1)], -1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], 1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.1: There are no trials yet. The starting architecture scores 0.000 on both seeds, so it probably isn't learning the task at all. Two weaknesses seem likely. First, the network has no direct way to work out where a brick lands: the landing layer is the highest point under the footprint, and the placement is right only if the target has those cells at that layer and nothing missing gets covered underneath. Max/min pooling over mixed channels gives only a rough version of this. Second, the default recipe allows only about 32 PPO updates, which is very few policy-improvement steps. I propose a 2x2 test. A: a layer-by-layer head with the default recipe. B: the starting network with a recipe that gives more updates. C: both changes together. This separates the effect of the architecture from the effect of the recipe. If all three still score 0, either the reward is the bottleneck or the world differs from its description.
analyses.2: Every trial so far scored 0 on dev, and success in the last 10% of training was also 0. Neither the layer-factored head nor two PPO epochs (about 230k samples, about 118 updates) produced any exact builds. With no signal at all, the training budget is the most likely bottleneck. Training took only about 90 of the allowed 900 seconds, and samples were scarce. A single PPO epoch gives about 426k samples, roughly 3.3 times the default. A higher gamma (0.99) passes the +1 exact-build bonus back across 6–16 placements, and a lower entropy weight lets the policy commit among about 250 actions. This round uses that recipe in all three candidates and varies the network: the baseline net alone, the baseline with a deeper dilated CNN that sees the whole grid, and a cell-token transformer for global reasoning about build order. If all three still score 0, the next step is a much bigger change to the reward horizon or the recipe.
analyses.3: All six trials scored exactly 0, both on dev and on training success in the last 10% of training. That held across two recipes (default, and 1 epoch with about 400k samples), a deeper dilated CNN, a transformer and a layer-factored head. Seed noise cannot explain results that are zero everywhere. Some bottleneck is shared by every design so far. The common part is the min/max/avg footprint-pooling head. Pooling throws away which footprint cell holds which column, so the head may be unable to tell whether a brick lands exactly on target cells. The phrase "world may differ" also allows that the anchor or footprint convention differs from the description, and the pooling head assumes it exactly. So this round tests heads that keep each cell's identity: a footprint-unfold MLP using a square kernel (k = max(dy, dx), which works for either orientation), and a 3x3 head centred on the anchor (which works for any anchor convention). It also crosses the unfold head with a 2-epoch recipe.
analyses.4: All nine trials scored exactly 0 on dev, and 0 on training success in the last 10% of training. That holds across four kinds of heads (pooling, layer-factored, unfold, centred 3x3), three trunks (shallow CNN, deeper CNN, attention) and recipes with 1, 2 and 4 PPO epochs. Seed noise cannot explain a uniform zero. Every head so far assumes that an action index lines up spatially with the observation cell at its anchor. The task warns that this world may not behave as described, so if actions are laid out differently (for example with obs transposed relative to the action index), every head was scoring the wrong cells. The last round therefore tests heads that make no such assumption. All three also feed the action mask in as input channels, because the mask shows per-action legality whatever the layout. Any score above 0 would beat the start.
